results.title: The fake commute: How China's unemployed save face
results.description: Unemployed individuals in China are pretending to be employed to avoid family concerns about their jobless situation. Many are sharing tips online about how to navigate daily life while hiding their unemployment status. This behavior reflects the challenges posed by a struggling economy and increased job competition. As some individuals receive unemployment benefits, societal pressure from family members adds to their anxiety.

results.title: UK unemployment rate falls in pre-budget boost, but firms keep cutting vacancies – business live
results.description: Rolling coverage of the latest economic and financial news Vacancies fell particularly sharply across the construction sector, suggesting Britain’s builders cut back on hiring last summer. The ONS reports: Vacancy estimates decreased on the quarter, with early estimates for July to September 2026 suggesting a decrease of 21,000 (2.9%) vacancies to 691,000, compared with April to June 2026; this is the first time the total has been below 700,000 since February to April 2021. Vacancy estimates decreased in 14 of the 18 industry sectors, compared with April to June 2026; the largest industry decrease was in construction (down 7,000 vacancies). Vacancy estimates decreased in 4 of the 5 employment size bands, compared with April to June 2026; the largest decrease was for businesses with 1 to 9 employees (down 21,000 vacancies).
